script_text:
Capricorn, silence the doubt; your massive career spotlight arrives sooner than you expect this entire week.

Early week brings Mercury trining your Midheaven, sharpening your full professional strategy through Wednesday morning.

Your Earth element grounds the pressure, but Mars in the eighth house creates financial tension by Tuesday evening.

Mid-week shift: Venus conjuncts your Sun, activating public recognition or a genuine work romance.

This powerful alignment favors networking and potential collaboration with senior leadership today.

Late week brings Uranus squaring your Sun Friday, forcing unexpected innovation, while Pluto sextiles your second house to lock in long-term financial trust through Sunday night.

Best day: Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 10th House.

Worst day: Friday is hardest as Uranus triggers sudden, disruptive change.

Advice: Anchor your ambition in Saturn's stable discipline to manage the chaos.

CTA: Follow for daily updates on these movements.
